name: Arihant PLUS
description: Arihant PLUS offers secure online trading, stock market investing, mutual funds, IPO access, portfolio management, and research tools in one powerful investment platform.

events.d: View an order's status and event history.
View Demat holdings and profit and loss for the account.
See the account's available funds and balances.
Place a market, limit, cover, or bracket order for stocks, futures, or options.
Retrieve your order book or a specific order's status.
Find stock symbols on a selected exchange by company name or symbol. Optionally filter by instrument type, F&O eligibility, and result limit.
Cancel an open or pending trade order. Executed, cancelled, and rejected orders cannot be cancelled.
Retrieve your order book and optionally filter by order ID, status, or symbol.
Change an order's quantity, price, type, trigger/limit prices, and other order details.
